author: touropia
description: Some countries just have the whole tourism thing figured out, and the numbers don't lie. One country welcomed more than 100 million international visitors last year, but it's far from the only destination attracting travelers by the millions. These aren't just popular vacation spots. They're the countries that keep topping travel rankings, filling hotels months in advance, and drawing visitors back year after year. A few entries might surprise you, but every country on this list has become a global tourism heavyweight. Let's see which destinations attracted the most visitors.
title: 12 Most Visited Countries in the World - Travel Video
